map.圆管散热 q = 2πλ(Tw−Ta)/ln(Do/Di)；临界保温厚度 δ_c: Pipe heat loss q = 2πλ(Tw−Ta)/ln(Do/Di); critical insulation thickness δ_c = λ/h
map.依据圆管一维稳态导热计算散热热流，并校核临界保温厚度与表面温度须低于规范限值、散: Based on one-dimensional steady-state cylindrical conduction, compute heat flux and verify the critical insulation thickness; surface temperature must stay below the code limit and heat loss be controllable before setting the outer thickness.
map.💡 稳态热平衡：(Tw−Ts)·2λ/ln(Do/D) = (Ts−Ta)·h·: 💡 Steady-state heat balance: (Tw−Ts)·2λ/ln(Do/D) = (Ts−Ta)·h·Do; heat loss q=π·Do·h·(Ts−Ta) (W/m). Surface heat-transfer coefficient h = 10 W/m²·K (convection+radiation).
map.本计算采用控制表面温度法（防烫/经济），适用于一般工业管道保温初算: This uses the surface-temperature control method (anti-scald/economic), for general industrial pipe insulation preliminary design

map.防烫伤/节能校核：表面温度须低于规范限值且散热可控: Anti-scald/energy-check: surface temperature must stay below code limit and heat loss controllable
map.改造核算：已知管材与保温导热系数确定外包厚度: Retrofit accounting: given pipe and insulation conductivity, set outer thickness
map.稳态圆柱导热：(Tw−Ts)×2×λ − (Ts−Ta)×h×Do×ln(Do/: Steady-state cylindrical conduction: (Tw−Ts)×2×λ − (Ts−Ta)×h×Do×ln(Do/D)=0, where Tw pipe wall temp, Ts allowable surface temp, Ta ambient, λ insulation conductivity, D pipe OD, h surface coefficient (~10 W/m²K), Do insulated OD (solved numerically between D and D+2). After Do, insulation thickness=(Do−D)/2.
map.Tw=200℃、Ta=25℃、λ=0.04 W/mK、管外径 D=108mm、允: Tw=200℃, Ta=25℃, λ=0.04 W/mK, pipe OD D=108mm, allowable Ts=50℃: solved insulated OD Do≈149.0mm, insulation thickness≈20.5mm ((149−108)/2); surface temp held below 50℃ is both anti-scald and heat-limiting.
map.表面换热系数 h 取多少？: What value for surface coefficient h?
map.室内/无风约 8~10、室外有风 12~20 W/m²K；h 越大散热越快、所需: Indoor/calm ≈8~10, outdoor windy 12~20 W/m²K; larger h dissipates faster and needs thicker insulation — this example takes 10 as a conventional conservative value.
map.为什么用圆柱导热而非平壁？: Why cylindrical conduction rather than flat wall?
map.管道是圆柱，导热面积随半径增大，须用 ln(Do/D) 的对数关系；误用平壁公式: Pipes are cylindrical; the conduction area grows with radius, requiring the ln(Do/D) logarithmic relation; misusing the flat-wall formula underestimates thickness and causes surface overheating.
map.管道保温层厚度计算器基于稳态圆柱壁导热模型，以控制保温外表面温度为目标，通过数值: Pipe insulation-thickness calculator is based on a steady-state cylindrical-wall conduction model, aiming to control the insulation outer-surface temperature, numerically iterating the required thickness and accounting for heat loss and energy-saving rate before and after insulation.
map.同时输出散热损失与节能率: Outputs heat loss and energy-saving rate
